operations.name: Delete a bank account
operations.description: Deleting a bank account is irreversible and reaches past the account itself. It removes every transaction the account holds, and — unless another account shares it — the accounting journal attached to it together with every accounting entry written in that journal. There is no undo, and no export is taken first. Three cases are refused rather than deleted, so the destructive path is narrow: — 409

How long payments actually take over a period: average and median days from the document date
and from the due date, plus the share paid late
operations.description: Answers "do my customers pay me on time, and how late are they?". Read the medians rather than the averages — the mean is dragged by a small tail of very late payers, so it can report a month's delay where the typical invoice is paid on time.
